zh: 两个单词“形状相同”，等价于把其中一个整体平移若干个字母得到另一个，这时它们相邻字母的有符号差值序列完全一样。
把每个单词转成相邻字母的差值序列当作签名（保留正负号，不取绝对值）；有 n−1 个单词的签名相同，只有答案的签名与众不同。
计算所有单词的签名并统计每种签名出现的次数，输出签名只出现一次的那个单词；n≥3 保证多数签名至少出现两次，不会混淆。
en: Two words have the same shape exactly when one is the other shifted by a fixed number of letters, and then their sequences of signed differences between adjacent letters are identical.

Turn each word into its sequence of adjacent-letter differences and use it as a signature (keep the sign, do not take absolute values); n-1 words share one signature and only the answer has a different one.

Compute every word's signature, count how often each signature occurs, and output the word whose signature occurs exactly once; n >= 3 guarantees the majority signature appears at least twice, so there is no ambiguity.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Compare the directed sequences of adjacent-letter differences. For example, ACB and BDC are both (+2,-1).

## Proof of correctness

The problem guarantees that exactly one word has a difference signature different from all the others. After counting the signatures, the only word whose signature occurs exactly once is the answer.

## Complexity

O(nL), space O(nL).
